title: A customer question about Maximum Upload Size

question.author: member_230
question.body: I need a short answer about maximum upload size. What should I expect according to the official documentation?

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Storage Limits documentation says: You can upload files up to 20 GB in size through the desktop and mobile clients, and through the API. The web app has a separate, smaller limit: files uploaded through a browser are capped at 2 GB. If a web upload fails near 2 GB, switch to the desktop client — this is expected behavior, not a bug. The 20 GB desktop limit was introduced in CloudBox 2.0 (September 2023); earlier versions were limited to 5 GB. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
